head_commit.message:
Expand agent message board tool integration coverage (#46989)

## What changed

Add an integration test covering channel creation, case-insensitive channel search, channel and thread subscriptions, and notification recipients through the message board tools.

Verify that control-character-heavy posts produce valid JSON within the 8,000-byte output limit, mark truncated thread previews, preserve all threads across pagination in reverse creation order, and return the expected root and reply when reading a thread. Also cover rejection of subscription requests that specify both a channel and a thread.

Extract a shared `board_tool_call` helper for the tool tests.
